name: Monstrous Affairs
source:
On your debut into Regency society, you not only find yourself in a den of high-society monsters, but also implicated in murder! Can you find love and prove your innocence?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
当你首次踏入摄政社会时，你不仅发现自己身处上流社会怪物的巢穴，而且还涉嫌谋杀！你能找到爱情并证明自己的清白吗？

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用程序[/url]]
